tools.name: realtimeregister_check_domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is available to register, with its price if it is premium. Check one name per call and wait at least one second before the next call (vendor acceptable use policy). Realtime Register API: GET /domains/{domainName}/check.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_domains
tools.description: List the domains in the customer account, with expiry dates, name servers and status. Use limit and offset to page through them. Realtime Register API: GET /domains/.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_domain
tools.description: Get one domain in the customer account: registrant, contacts, name servers, status, expiry and auto-renew settings. Realtime Register API: GET /domains/{domainName}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_domain_zone
tools.description: Get the DNS zone that belongs to a domain, with its records and SOA settings. Realtime Register API: GET /domains/{domainName}/zone.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_dns_zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the customer account. Use limit and offset to page through them. Realtime Register API: GET /dns/zones/.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_dns_zone
tools.description: Get one DNS zone by id, with its records and SOA settings. Read the zone before any update. Realtime Register API: GET /dns/zones/{id}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (registrant and admin records) of the customer account. Realtime Register API: GET /customers/{customer}/contacts/.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by handle. Realtime Register API: GET /customers/{customer}/contacts/{handle}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_hosts
tools.description: List the host objects (name servers with glue addresses) in the customer account. Realtime Register API: GET /hosts/.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_host
tools.description: Get one host object by its name, such as ns1.example.com. Realtime Register API: GET /hosts/{hostName}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_credit
tools.description: Get the prepaid credit balance of the customer account. Domain orders are paid from this balance. Realtime Register API: GET /customers/{customer}/credit.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_process
tools.description: Get the status of an asynchronous process, such as a domain update or a DNS zone change. Use the id from a write call's response. Realtime Register API: GET /processes/{id}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_tld_info
tools.description: Get the registry metadata for a TLD, such as its rules and the fields it requires. Realtime Register API: GET /tlds/{tld}/info.

tools.name: realtimeregister_update_dns_zone
tools.description: Change the SOA settings, name servers or records of a DNS zone. Read the zone first with realtimeregister_get_dns_zone and send only the fields you change. Changes reach the public internet after DNS caches expire. Send writes one at a time, at least one second apart (vendor acceptable use policy).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: realtimeregister_update_dns_zone · Private data: realtimeregister_get_domain, realtimeregister_get_domain_zone, realtimeregister_get_dns_zone, realtimeregister_list_contacts, realtimeregister_get_contact, realtimeregister_update_dns_zone · Public sink: realtimeregister_update_dns_zone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: realtimeregister_update_dns_zone · Private data: realtimeregister_get_domain, realtimeregister_get_domain_zone, realtimeregister_get_dns_zone, realtimeregister_list_contacts, realtimeregister_get_contact, realtimeregister_update_dns_zone · Public sink: realtimeregister_update_dns_zone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
